readme: MCP client options (plugin-settings@1): the keys in plugin.json settings.options, served from this plugin's config.json through server/plugin_options.py. The servers list is read-only here (GET /servers); servers are added and edited in the MCP servers panel.

settings.label: Timeout per call (seconds)
settings.description: How long the console waits for an MCP server before the call fails. Default: AXF_MCP_TIMEOUT, else 30.
